name: Raspberry-Basil Quinoa Spinach Salad with Orange, Pecans & Goat Cheese

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (170 g) pkg raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Place in a large bowl along with the spinach.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the orange and spinach.
Pick basil leaves off the stems. Roll half of the basil leaves up crosswise, thinly slice into ribbons, and add to the bowl. Place remaining (whole) basil leaves in a blender.

Add half of the raspberries to the bowl and set aside. Add remaining raspberries to the blender with the basil along with oil, vinegar, water, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until smooth, then set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Once the quinoa is cool, add to the bowl, along with the pecans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Crumble goat cheese over top and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
